item.title: Tuesday rec paddle
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description: There didn’t seem to me a lot going on tonight, so I borrowed a G3 and joined Terry’s rec paddle group. It was fairly calm conditions, and I had a chance to chat with a few people. We followed the east side of the sound for a few miles.

item.title: Exeter Canal
item.author: paul@insightsforaction.uk (Paul Hewson)
item.description: This was Debbie’s first time paddling for a while. We opted not to go to Broadsands but instead chose Exeter Canal. We parked at Bromham’s Farm Car Park (I always want to call this Clapperbrook Lane Carpark, but that’s the official name. I guess now there is a train station there they council had to do something and pay by phone means they don’t need to install any infrastructure. It is free for 2 hours, as long as you use RingGo).
